name: Quicknode

designationEvidence.contains: member of the Quicknode Startup Program

guidance: three.ws is a member of the Quicknode Startup Program with approved infrastructure credits. Say that and nothing grander: it is a program membership, not an endorsement, certification or exclusive arrangement. Quicknode is one premium lane among several in the Solana RPC failover chain, enabled by an endpoint URL configured on the server, so never call it the primary or only provider and never say three.ws runs on Quicknode. Talk about the outcome: capacity and redundancy behind agent wallets and x402 settlement verification. Never state a credit amount.

features.title: Verify an x402 settlement on Solana
features.summary: One GET to verify-receipt checks a real x402 settlement signature against the Solana chain and answers with a finalized status and slot, reading through the same RPC failover chain that Quicknode capacity feeds.

The verify-receipt endpoint looks a Solana signature up and answers whether the settlement is confirmed.

Server-side Solana calls do not depend on a single endpoint: a failover chain rotates past endpoints that are rate-limited or cooling down.
